name: MAVEN
tagline: Mars atmospheric loss to solar wind
description: NASA's atmospheric orbiter at Mars — Mars Atmosphere and Volatile EvolutioN. In Mars orbit from 2014 until contact was lost in December 2025, it studied how the planet lost its early thick atmosphere to solar wind erosion over billions of years.
best_known_for: Studying Mars atmospheric loss to solar wind; revealed Mars lost its atmosphere over billions of years
